Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
<joe...@rain.org> wrote:
>1) Can you have more than 4 vampires in your uncontrolled region?...

Sure.

>2) When a minion is attacked through a <D> action, is that minion tapped
>if it doesn't block? (I assume no)

It does not block. NOte that there had been talk of changing the rule
on this, but a minion doesn't tap simply because it enters combat.

>3) Where do the life points come from for Allies & Retainers? (the blood
>bank, since on some, you're already paying pool to recruit/employ them?)

They just have life points. However you want to represent this is up
to you; using blood counters is the most common method, since you know
you're going to have some handy, but it's not actually blood points.

>4) Does a Flak Jacket prevent the first damage in a combat, or is it the
>choice of the controlling Meth?

It can be used whenever desired, but only once.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
